proof_body:
by
  intro F₀ f₀ U₀ hU₀ hp₀ hd₀ hl₀ hi₀
  have hurwitz : ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop U → (∀ n, ∀ z ∈ U, F n z ≠ 0) → (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0) ∨ (∀ z ∈ U, f z ≠ 0) := by
    intro F f U hU hp hd hl h0
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨⟨a, haU, ha⟩, ⟨c, hcU, hc⟩⟩ := hcon
    have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U := hl.differentiableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hd) hU
    have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f U := hfd.analyticOnNhd hU
    rcases (hfa c hcU).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hz | hne
    · have := hfa.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hp hcU hz
      exact ha (this haU)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, z ∈ U ∧ (z ≠ c → f z ≠ 0) :=
      Filter.Eventually.and (hU.mem_nhds hcU) (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hne)
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev
    set r := ε / 2 with hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ Metric.ball c ε := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hr]; linarith)
    have hcU' : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ U := fun z hz => (hball z (hcb hz)).1
    have hsne : (Metric.sphere c r).Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr hr0.le
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_sphere c r).exists_isMinOn hsne ((hfd.continuousOn.mono (fun z hz => hcU' (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))).norm)
    have hxne : x ≠ c := by
      intro h
      rw [h, mem_sphere_iff_norm, sub_self, norm_zero] at hx
      exact hr0.ne hx
    have hm : 0 < ‖f x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ((hball x (hcb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hx))).2 hxne)
    have hu := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hU).mp hl _ hcU' (isCompact_closedBall c r)
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hu
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (hu (‖f x‖ / 2) (by positivity)).exists
    have hsph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c r, ‖f x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖F n z‖ := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 := hn z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
      have h2 : ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := hmin hz
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
      have h3 := norm_sub_norm_le (f z) (F n z)
      linarith
    have hcen : ‖F n c‖ < ‖f x‖ / 2 := by
      have h1 := hn c (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr0.le)
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hc, zero_sub, norm_neg] at h1
      exact h1
    have hinv : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => (F n z)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c r) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball c hr0.ne']
      exact ((hd n).mono hcU').inv (fun z hz => h0 n z (hcU' hz))
    have hbd := Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le (U := Metric.ball c r) (z := c) Metric.isBounded_ball hinv (C := (‖f x‖ / 2)⁻¹) (by
      intro z hz
      rw [frontier_ball c hr0.ne'] at hz
      simp only [norm_inv]
      exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (hsph z hz)) (subset_closure (Metric.mem_ball_self hr0))
    rw [norm_inv] at hbd
    have hp2 : 0 < ‖F n c‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h0 n c hcU)
    have := (inv_le_inv₀ hp2 (by positivity)).mp hbd
    linarith
  by_cases hinj : Set.InjOn f₀ U₀
  · exact Or.inl hinj
  right
  rw [Set.InjOn] at hinj
  push_neg at hinj
  obtain ⟨a, haU, b, hbU, hab, hne⟩ := hinj
  have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ := hl₀.differentiableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hd₀) hU₀
  have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f₀ z - f₀ b) U₀ := (hfd.sub_const _).analyticOnNhd hU₀
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU₀ a haU
  set r := min ε (dist a b) with hr
  have hdab : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.mpr hne
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_min hε hdab
  have hsub : Metric.ball a r ⊆ U₀ := (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hεU
  have hbout : b ∉ Metric.ball a r := by
    intro h
    have h1 : dist b a < r := h
    have h2 : r ≤ dist a b := min_le_right _ _
    rw [dist_comm] at h1
    linarith
  have hb₀ := hl₀.tendsto_at hbU
  have hG : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => F₀ n z - F₀ n b) (fun z => f₀ z - f₀ b) Filter.atTop (Metric.ball a r) := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff] at hl₀ ⊢
    intro δ hδ x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hev⟩ := hl₀ (δ / 2) (by positivity) x (hsub hx)
    refine ⟨t ∩ Metric.ball a r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : t ∈ nhds x := by
        rwa [hU₀.nhdsWithin_eq (hsub hx)] at ht
      rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq hx]
      exact Filter.inter_mem h1 (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
    · have hb1 := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hb₀) (δ / 2) (by positivity)
      filter_upwards [hev, hb1] with n h1 h2 y hy
      have h3 := h1 y hy.1
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2 h3 ⊢
      have e : f₀ y - f₀ b - (F₀ n y - F₀ n b) = (f₀ y - F₀ n y) + (F₀ n b - f₀ b) := by ring
      rw [e]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_add_le _ _) ?_
      linarith
  have hH := hurwitz (fun n z => F₀ n z - F₀ n b) (fun z => f₀ z - f₀ b) (Metric.ball a r) Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball a r).isPreconnected (fun n => ((hd₀ n).mono hsub).sub_const _) hG (by
    intro n z hz h
    apply hbout
    have : z = b := hi₀ n (hsub hz) hbU (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
    rwa [← this])
  have hmem : a ∈ Metric.ball a r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr0
  rcases hH with hall | hnz
  · have hev : (fun z => f₀ z - f₀ b) =ᶠ[nhds a] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hmem] with z hz using hall z hz
    have hzero := hfa.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hp₀ haU hev
    intro z hz w hw
    have h1 : f₀ z - f₀ b = 0 := hzero hz
    have h2 : f₀ w - f₀ b = 0 := hzero hw
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
  · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mpr hab) (hnz a hmem)
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop U → (∀ n, Set.InjOn (F n) U) → Set.InjOn f U ∨ ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, f z = f w
